text_diff: +Upstash's Context7 serves up-to-date docs to AI coding agents. Context.dev powers the website crawling behind it at millions of requests a day, and Claude set up the integration in minutes.

-SiteGPT, the AI chatbot platform for customer support, switched from Firecrawl to Context.dev to scrape entire websites and turn them into the knowledge base behind its customers' bots. The migration took under a day.

+Incredible AX! Claude handled all the setup for me. It wasn't longer than a few minutes until we started a few benchmarks with our previous crawling service and already saw the benefits and improvements.
